_description: Paper-baseline overlay for Step 15. Lowers sample-collection thresholds without relaxing hard risk caps.

alpha_gate._description: Collect enough paper samples while preserving EV gating and existing leverage/exposure caps.

confidence_gate._description: Slightly easier paper-stage confirmation to improve sample throughput. Does not change stop/risk controls.

gambler._description: Disable high-risk heavy-bet overrides during paper sample collection to avoid unrelated T1 vetoes.

structure_gate._description: Sample-collection paper runs can take reduced-size near-break entries instead of idling for every unbroken fractal.

weekend_manager._description: Weekend paper-baseline favors sample throughput, but still keeps gross and per-asset weekend caps in place.
